messages:
maya (PM): Quick thread to align on tenant prewarm + isolation for the pilot. Need concrete handoffs for infra, runtime, platform, and security. Short answers please. :wave:

kevin (eng-runtime): Two main asks: 1) how strict is tenant isolation (separate processes vs shared with KV namespaces)? 2) acceptable cold-start window when prewarm fails?

sara (infra): We can offer soft isolation: shared runtime, strict KV namespaces + network ACLs. For hard isolation (separate infra), lead time is 4 weeks. Soft isolation ala namespaces gives 95% of isolation without full infra carve-outs.

maya (PM): Pilot uses soft isolation. Customers want cost efficiency. We'll list hard isolation as enterprise opt-in post-pilot.

tom (security): Soft isolation is acceptable if we can show no cross-tenant KV leakage and full audit logs. Need a short proof plan: unit test demonstrating namespace separation + e2e test for cache eviction.

aditi (eng-sre): Operational point: if prewarm jobs spike, we need SLOs for retries and backpressure. Recommend a circuit-breaker: max 3 prewarm attempts per tenant per window and queue backoff. Also need alerting channel for prewarm failures.

kevin (eng-runtime): Implementation sketch: prewarm job will reserve KV slots and pin model weights for X minutes. If reservation fails, fallback to on-demand cold start + enqueue background prewarm. We'll expose metrics: prewarm_reservations, prewarm_failures, prewarm_latency.

liam (eng-platform): Platform changes: add two flags to route.policy: "isolation_mode" (soft|hard) and "prewarm_attempts". Console should show prewarm status per-tenant and link to metrics. API example below:

```
{
  "route.policy": "{\"prewarm_attempts\":3,\"isolation_mode\":\"soft\"}"
}
```

jen (solutions): I'll add a customer-facing checklist: expected behavior matrix (prewarm success, prewarm queued, fallback route), how to trigger manual prewarm, and test harness steps. Will attach sample load script.

maya (PM): Decisions: 1) soft isolation for pilot, 2) circuit-breaker for prewarm attempts (3), 3) platform exposes isolation_mode + prewarm_attempts, 4) security requires proof tests and audit log spec.

sara (infra): Action: I'll open capacity ticket and propose namespace ACLs + peering config by Thurs COB. ETA: 2 weeks to apply to staging.

kevin (eng-runtime): Action: I'll land prewarm reservation + fallback logic. PR target: Tue. Tests: unit test for namespace separation + integration for reservation failure path.

liam (eng-platform): Action: API + UI PR for route.policy flags by Wed. Will include metric links in Console.

aditi (eng-sre): Action: alert playbook + circuit-breaker runbook. Will draft runbook and alert thresholds by Tue.

tom (security): Action: I'll write the proof plan for KV isolation + audit log fields we need. Expect review window 3 business days after infra ticket.

deploy-bot: CI: feature/prewarm-isolation passed unit tests -> staging deploy queued (build 2059). :rocket:

maya (PM): Thanks. If infra or security find anything blocking, flag here ASAP. Otherwise I'll publish the pilot launch criteria doc tomorrow with these inputs. :spiral_calendar:
